title: I pasted a script and got back a finished short
repository_description: Give it a script (or a topic and your own AI key) and it builds the voice, subtitles, music and edit of a short video.

verified_features.label: VOICE
verified_features.claim: Turns the script into a voice-over (here through its Kokoro provider; Edge, Azure and other voices in source).
verified_features.evidence: run: 'kokoro tts succeeded' -> audio.mp3; app/services/voice.py:2789 kokoro_tts, :1525 azure_tts_v1

verified_features.label: SUBTITLES
verified_features.claim: Writes sentence-timed subtitles and burns them into the video.
verified_features.evidence: run: subtitle.srt with 4 cues, visible in final-1.mp4; app/services/task.py:643, voice.py:3658

verified_features.label: MUSIC
verified_features.claim: Mixes a background track under the voice.
verified_features.evidence: run: --bgm-type random; final mix has no silences where the voice-only track has 3; app/services/video.py:877 get_bgm_file

verified_features.label: EDIT
verified_features.claim: Cuts and fits the clips to a 1080x1920 vertical video that matches the voice length.
verified_features.evidence: run: 'combining video' / 'generating video' -> final-1.mp4 1080x1920 10.0 s; app/services/video.py:965 combine_videos, :1558 generate_video

verified_features.label: SCRIPT
verified_features.claim: Can write the script (and footage keywords) from a topic using an LLM provider you configure with your own API key.
verified_features.evidence: app/services/llm.py:880 generate_script, :1009 generate_terms; WebUI 'Generate Script & Keywords with AI' button (screenshot)

verified_features.label: WEB UI · CLI · API
verified_features.claim: Has a web UI, a command line and an HTTP API.
verified_features.evidence: WebUI run and screenshotted on 127.0.0.1:8501; cli.py run; app/controllers/v1/video.py:212 POST /videos (source)

demonstration.meaning: the project's own code was run in the build environment; the picture re-draws that run
notes: Every video frame inside the phone is MoneyPrinterTurbo's own output (final-1.mp4), shown muted.
The WebUI image is a screenshot of MoneyPrinterTurbo's real Streamlit UI with the episode's topic, script and keywords typed in; the AI buttons were not pressed.
Terminal lines are re-typed verbatim fragments of the real run log (stage names), drawn in the series style.

verification.method: Cloned the repository, read README-en.md, LICENSE, requirements.txt, cli.py and app/services; installed requirements.txt in an isolated venv (Python 3.13; pyproject requires >= 3.11); ran the unmodified CLI end to end; ran the Streamlit WebUI on 127.0.0.1 and screenshotted it with headless Chromium.
verification.run_command: python cli.py --video-script "<the 3-sentence fractal script>" --video-terms mandelbrot,fractal --video-source local --video-materials fractal_a.mp4,fractal_b.mp4,fractal_c.mp4 --video-concat-mode sequential --video-clip-duration 4 --voice-name kokoro:af_heart --video-aspect 9:16 --subtitle-enabled --font-size 78 --subtitle-background-enabled --rounded-subtitle-background --bgm-type random
verification.run_result: exit 0; log stages: generating audio -> kokoro tts succeeded -> generating subtitle -> subtitle file created -> preprocess local materials -> combining video -> generating video -> finished, generated 1 videos; output 1080x1920 H.264/AAC, 10.0 s, 4 subtitle cues; the bundled background track fills the 3 pauses of the voice-only track.
environment_limits: Edge TTS, Hugging Face (Whisper models) and stock-footage APIs are not reachable from the build environment, and no paid LLM / footage API was used.

Voice: MPT's own [kokoro] provider (OpenAI-compatible /v1/audio/speech) pointed at a local 127.0.0.1:8880 server backed by Kokoro-82M via kokoro-onnx, standing in for remsky/Kokoro-FastAPI. MPT's code was not modified.
Footage: original Mandelbrot zoom clips rendered with ffmpeg (no stock footage), passed with --video-source local.
Script: supplied with --video-script, so the LLM script step was skipped (that feature is verified in source only).
Not tested: Windows / macOS (README lists Windows, macOS, Linux; the run was on Linux), GPU, Docker, the API server, uploads.

instagram_caption:
I pasted a script into an open-source GitHub project, and it handed back a finished vertical short 👀

Voice, subtitles, music and the edit: all done by MoneyPrinterTurbo. Give it your own AI key and it can write the script from a topic too.

How this demo was made: I ran it locally from its CLI with my own script, original fractal clips and a local Kokoro voice. No paid API was used.
